axes.selection: one shared orthonormal basis E (1024 x 1024), the top eigenvectors of the identity second moment of the residual stream pooled over all 29 residual-write endpoints with each endpoint equalised to trace one; a per-boundary chart is not expressible in a stock child because the residual is a running sum with nowhere to put a chart transition.  The conv blocks' internal channels are a pivoted-Cholesky coreset of the parent's own, because Lfm2ShortConv gates channelwise and no rotation of that space is representable
axes.solve: closed form only: readers exact, writers projected, no re-solve
axes.evidence: sequentially conditioned capture through the partially built child

axes.selection: pivoted-Cholesky coreset of real channels, ranked on the CHILD's OWN gated intermediate captured through the live narrowed body -- the MLP counterpart of the conv coreset's `parent_gated_rows`, and equal to the parent's gated intermediate at the lifted row up to bf16 because the reader fold is exact there; w1/w3 rows kept verbatim from the FOLDED readers, which is the same object as folding the parent's kept rows because the basis and the coreset commute
axes.solve: closed form only: the folded writer truncated to the kept columns, no re-solve
axes.evidence: sequentially conditioned capture through the partially built child: block i's census sees every narrowing above it

solver_path: mx36_build.fold_reader/fold_writer (closed-form basis fold, fp64 CPU) + mx36_build.narrow_mlp_site (pivoted-Cholesky coreset of the CHILD's own gated intermediate, per block, in forward order)
